## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: (1) Sector returns are split with Energy, Consumer Staples and Healthcare outpacing Materials, Utilities and Industrials; (2) leadership is narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Tech) and there is major divergence among large caps, so no clear directional conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +10.34%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.27% | 1M: +10.99%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples/Discretionary support: WMT (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.78%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strength: UNH (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +20.48%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: CRH (1W: -7.82% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -8.97% | 1M: -5.71%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak: VST (1W: -10.06% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -12.44% | 1M: -11.41%) BELOW TREND. Industrials showing stress: BA (1W: -7.39% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -5.73%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
CSCO (1W: +20.42% | 1M: +37.83%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +47.48%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +13.04% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND; SYK (1W: +10.84% | 1M: -8.77%) RECOVERY; F (1W: +9.50% | 1M: +2.52%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Tech) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
BA (1W: -7.39% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND; CRH (1W: -7.82% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -7.87% | 1M: +2.34%) CORRECTION; AMD (1W: -8.24% | 1M: +51.22%) CORRECTION; ETN (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -5.73%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials/Materials with notable Tech pullbacks.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: CSCO (1W: +20.42% | 1M: +37.83%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +47.48%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +13.04% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND; watch pronounced divergences in big-cap semis (INTC, QCOM, AMD) where 1W falls conflict with strong 1M gains — major divergence, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed — leaders and fatigued names coexist. AAPL (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +10.32%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +0.18%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +10.23%) ABOVE TREND while INTC (1W: -16.43% | 1M: +57.91%) CORRECTION and QCOM (1W: -14.27% | 1M: +49.52%) CORRECTION — sector breadth positive but internal rotation apparent.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed-to-constructive. CME (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.24% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY — Financials are contributing to the market’s split tape.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Tonal split with pockets of strength. UNH (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +20.48%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.38% | 1M: -2.25%) RECOVERY and PFE (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.57%) BELOW TREND — monitor news-driven idiosyncratic risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and high-quality Financials (XOM, CME, V) and monitor technology leaders for follow-through; reduce exposure to structurally weak Utilities/Materials names (VST, CRH) and lagging Industrials (BA, ETN). Style: mixed with a slight Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy/Financial strength, but narrow Tech leadership argues selectivity.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CSCO (1W: +20.42% | 1M: +37.83%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +10.34%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -16.43% | 1M: +57.91%) CORRECTION, QCOM (1W: -14.27% | 1M: +49.52%) CORRECTION, BA (1W: -7.39% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +11.80%) showing strength, Financials (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -2.31%) providing support. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -2.76%), Utilities (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -4.48%) and Industrials (1W: -2.21% | 1M: -3.59%) at risk of further underperformance.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch CSCO for continuation above this week’s breakout high as confirmation of the tech short-squeeze momentum; XOM to hold recent gap and 50-day pace for Energy follow-through; AAPL to hold the 1M uptrend as tech bellwether; INTC/QCOM failing to reclaim this week’s lows would deepen the correction — monitor volume and news catalysts.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
D (+90): NextEra-Dominion mega-merger; D (1W: +7.99% | 1M: +8.23%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. XOM (+55): legal win and strong Q1; XOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +10.34%) ABOVE TREND — confirming. VST (+55): analyst upgrades but VST (1W: -10.06% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for possible catch-up or fading.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-50): headlines on Berkshire exit; UNH (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +20.48%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price still strong (divergence). LLY (-45): concerns around weight-loss competition; LLY (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging, monitor. HD (-45): demand concerns; HD (1W: -3.72% | 1M: -14.19%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed with a slight Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy and Financial strength. CSCO (1W: +20.42% | 1M: +37.83%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +10.34%) ABOVE TREND and CME (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large caps (INTC, QCOM, AMD, TSLA) and several sentiment/price divergences (UNH, VST) — monitor for trend confirmation before scaling core moves.
